slot_scores.name: truck_capacity_limit
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Since the cost is charged per container per kilometer regardless of truck sharing, does the truck capacity limit of 2 containers per trip impose any additional constraint on the model, such as a maximum number of containers that can be shipped on any single route, or is it purely descriptive information that does not affect the optimization?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent explicitly probed vehicle/capacity constraints and then asked directly about the truck capacity limit of 2 containers per trip and its modeling impact, confirming the hidden slot rather than silently assuming it.

stopping_behavior.rationale: The only hidden slot is P2 and was resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; no P0 or P1 hidden slots remained unresolved when the agent stopped.

summary: The agent asked targeted clarification questions, recovered the truck capacity hidden slot, confirmed its non-binding modeling role, and stopped after resolving all material ambiguities.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
